not the most powerful jacobs ladder ever, but REGARDLESS. it is awesome.

*SAFETY* - i would recommend only trying this if youve worked with high voltages before. because its lethal and it could KILL you and fry you for dinner. if you are stupid enough to die, im not responsible. its you being a silly cooked billy! take all precautions!!!!
